description.value: Super 8 by Wyndham Abbotsford BC is a budget motel on Sumas Way, well positioned along the Trans-Canada corridor as a practical overnight stop for cyclists travelling through the Fraser Valley. The property includes a swimming pool and in-house laundry. Guests benefit from a noted 10% discount at the adjacent Abbey Road Taphouse.

raw_osm.description: Also offers a 10% discount on purchases at the Abbey Road Taphouse for guests.
raw_osm.name: Super 8 by Wyndham Abbotsford BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content fetched is the generic Wyndham Hotels corporate booking interface with no property-specific amenity details visible in any of the subpages captured, so OSM tags serve as the primary evidence for amenity fields. OSM confirms laundry_service=yes, internet_access=wlan with internet_access:fee=no (free Wi-Fi), a swimming pool, and a partnership with the nearby Abbey Road Taphouse. No evidence exists in either source for any bike-specific amenities such as secure storage, staff bike procedures, or e-bike charging.
concerns: Website content captured is generic Wyndham corporate navigation UI with no property-specific amenity details; laundry and Wi-Fi claims rely solely on OSM tags and could not be confirmed via website.
Phone number and street address could not be verified from the fetched website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational Super 8 motel at a confirmed Abbotsford address; a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists on the Fraser Valley route.

Nearby evening food.detail: OSM description states Abbey Road Taphouse is nearby and guests receive a 10% discount on purchases there
